facts.business: VJTF Eduservices Limited is a Non-Banking Financial Company (NBFC-ND) registered with the RBI, engaged in making investments across diversified asset classes including equity shares, debentures, mutual funds, portfolio management services, and Alternative Investment Funds to optimize returns while maintaining a balanced risk profile.

auditor.name: R A N K & Associates LLP
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter on: 1) Company's NBFC registration status and withdrawal of surrender application; 2) Non-compliance with certain RBI directions, circulars and regulatory requirements; 3) CARO 2020 clauses 3(iii)(c), (d) and (f) regarding loans granted without stipulated repayment schedule.

key_risks: Fluctuations in the value of investments
facts.related_party_note: Material related party transactions during the year: 1) Deposit against building given to Witty Infratech Private Limited (₹2,840.00 lakhs given and ₹3,965.28 lakhs received back); 2) Unsecured loan of ₹257.00 lakhs availed from Dr. Vinay Jain, Managing Director; 3) Loans to VJTF Buildcon Private Limited (subsidiary) - ₹180.00 lakhs given and received back during the year, balance as at 31st March, 2026: Nil. All transactions were in ordinary course of business and on arm's length basis, approved by Audit Committee and Members.
